sloka: स रावणः समागम्य विधिवत् तेन रक्षसा ।मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा सर्व कामैः अमानुषैः ॥३-३५-३९॥
transliteration: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā ।mārīcena arcito rājā sarva kāmaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ ॥3-35-39॥

translations.english: When king Ravana reached there, Maricha received him in accordance with tradition and made worshipful offering to the king, fulfilling all his superhuman desires.
